note: Silhouette scores compare visible boundaries only, not internal geometry, wood, lighting or unseen surfaces. Original is authoritative.

internal_feature_review.head: Round upper sphere with the widest latitude raised to fit both originals; original physical apex-to-floor height retained.
internal_feature_review.collar: The accepted broad seat radius and collar remain attached to the lower head; the lower spherical flank curves into the seat.
internal_feature_review.stem: Curved narrow stem widens into an upper shoulder bead and a short lower wall; both original sprites inspected.
internal_feature_review.base: Compact turned base with a flatter sole edge; the existing front groove and upper flare remain inspection priorities.
internal_feature_review.limitations: The unseen surface, illumination and pigment are inferred. Compare fixed beauty, clay and rotating model separately.

mask_method: Largest component with holes filled; reference max RGB >12 and alpha >127, model alpha >127.
